recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片細胞量高，混合各階段顆粒球、紅血球前驅細胞，並散布許多核染色質細緻、胞質深藍的原始細胞（blasts），提示伴過量原始細胞的 MDS（MDS-EB／RAEB）。
features: Cellular marrow smear with mixed myeloid and erythroid precursors
Increased blasts: intermediate cells with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Segmented neutrophils and bands, some appearing hypogranular at this resolution
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and deep blue cytoplasm
Resolution limits assessment of subtle dyspoietic features and precise blast count
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows a cellular specimen with trilineage precursors and an apparent increase in blasts, which are intermediate-sized cells with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Maturing granulocytes, some appearing hypogranular, and erythroid precursors are present. Subtle dysplastic features and an exact blast percentage cannot be determined at this resolution and require a 500-cell differential. Findings are suggestive of myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: AML requires at least 20% blasts in blood or marrow (or a defining genetic abnormality), whereas MDS-EB has 5-19% marrow blasts by manual count.

ddx.dx: Regenerating marrow after chemotherapy or G-CSF
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a synchronous wave of promyelocytes with a clinical history of therapy and lacks persistent dysplasia or clonal cytogenetics.
CMML requires persistent peripheral monocytosis of at least 0.5 x 10^9/L and at least 10% monocytes, not seen in MDS-EB.
